> **Key points:**  
> • First Asian player to win the UEFA Champions League (with Man United, 2008).  
> • Won five consecutive Premier League titles (2007–08 through 2011–12).  
> • Earned over 100 caps for the Republic of Korea national team (106 appearances, 14 goals).

---

### International Career  
- Debuted for South Korea at age 16 against China (1998).  
- Represented his country at three FIFA World Cups (2002, 2006, 2010).  
- Played in two AFC Asian Cup tournaments (2004, 2010).  
- Captained the national side during the 2010 World Cup campaign.  

---

### Style of Play  
- Known for exceptional stamina, work rate, and tactical versatility.  
- Strong tackling, accurate passing, and ability to contribute offensively—often overlapping runs into wide areas.  
- Nicknamed “The Ironman” due to durability and consistency across seasons.

---

### Personal Life & Post‑Retirement  
- Married Kim Seong‑yeol (former Miss Universe Korea) in 2014; they have one son.  
- Retired from playing professionally after the 2015–16 season.  
- Since retirement he has worked as an analyst/commentator for various sports networks and served briefly as a coach/technical director for youth teams.  
- Active philanthropist: involved in several charitable foundations supporting children’s education and health initiatives in South Korea.
